name: ZOZO, Inc.
summary: ZOZO, Inc. operates online shopping Websites in Japan. It operates ZOZOTOWN a fashion online shopping website that includes services, such as ZOZOUSED, a website for secondhand/vintage apparel; ZOZOCOSME, an online cosmetic store; ZOZOSHOES, a shoe-specialized zone; and ZOZOVILLA that brings together domestic and international brands.
